inputs.original_text: DHS is using an ICE arrest to weaken New York City’s sanctuary policies and justify broader, harsher enforcement. That’s a familiar way institutions turn an individual case into suspicion directed at whole communities—especially immigrants already vulnerable to discrimination. Public safety should mean fair, accountable policies that protect everyone, not treating immigration status as evidence of danger or using fear to roll back protections.
inputs.modified_text: This looks less like a response to one arrest and more like an effort to turn an individual case into a pretext for dismantling New York City’s sanctuary protections. When institutions use fear to cast suspicion on whole immigrant communities, people already facing discrimination pay the price. Public safety means fair, accountable policies—not treating immigration status as proof of danger or using one case to justify harsher enforcement.
